settings.title: Orders & Shipping
Where do you ship?
settings.answer: We currently ship throughout the United States. Available shipping options and estimated delivery times are shown at checkout.

settings.title: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: In stock products typically ship after processing. Custom builds, modified hardware, and made to order items may need a little more time before they are ready to leave our hands.

settings.title: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order ships, tracking information will be sent to the email address provided at checkout.

settings.title: Do you insure shipments?
settings.answer: Higher value shipments may include insurance or additional delivery protection depending on the item and shipping method.

settings.title: Can I change or cancel an order?
settings.answer: Contact us as soon as possible. If your order has not entered fulfillment or custom work has not started, we may be able to make changes.

settings.title: PC Builds
Do you build custom gaming PCs?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Every build can be tailored around your budget, performance goals, aesthetics, and what you actually plan to do with it.

settings.title: Can I choose my own components?
settings.answer: Yes. Bring us a complete parts list, a few ideas, or nothing but a budget. We can take it from there.

settings.title: Can I supply my own parts?
settings.answer: Usually. We will review your components for compatibility and condition before starting the build.

settings.title: Do you only build gaming PCs?
settings.answer: No. Gaming, productivity, creative work, everyday use, or something a little ridiculous. If it needs a PC, we can build around it.

settings.title: Do you offer upgrades for existing PCs?
settings.answer: Yes. Sometimes you do not need a new computer. More memory, storage, a better GPU, improved cooling, or a few carefully chosen upgrades can completely change an existing system.

settings.title: Tech Repairs
What devices do you repair?
settings.answer: We work with computers, gaming consoles, handhelds, and other consumer technology. Send us the model and what is going wrong and we will let you know if we can help.

settings.title: How do I start a repair?
settings.answer: Send us a repair request with your device and a description of the problem. We will review it and walk you through what comes next.

settings.title: Can I mail my device in for repair?
settings.answer: Yes. Many repairs can be completed through mail in service. Shipping instructions are provided once we have reviewed your request.

settings.title: How long does a repair take?
settings.answer: It depends on the problem, parts availability, and the device itself. We will give you a realistic estimate once we know what we are working with.

settings.title: Can you repair something another shop already worked on?
settings.answer: Usually. Just tell us what has already been repaired, replaced, or attempted. No judgment. We like a challenge.

settings.title: Restoration & Mods
What hardware do you restore?
settings.answer: We specialize in giving worthwhile hardware another life, including consoles, handhelds, computers, and other electronics.

settings.title: What kind of modifications do you offer?
settings.answer: It depends on the hardware. Upgrades, shells, displays, storage, cooling, cosmetic work, and other modifications may be available depending on the device.

settings.title: Can you restore old or damaged consoles?
settings.answer: That is kind of our thing. Send us some details and photos and we can determine what can realistically be brought back.

settings.title: Can you build something completely custom?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Some of our favorite projects start with an idea that does not fit neatly on a service menu.

settings.title: Will modifying my device affect its manufacturer warranty?
settings.answer: It can. Repairs, modifications, or aftermarket components may affect manufacturer coverage, so check your warranty before having a device modified.

settings.title: Data Recovery
What devices can you recover data from?
settings.answer: Depending on the problem, we may be able to recover data from computers, hard drives, SSDs, flash storage, and other devices.

settings.title: Is data recovery guaranteed?
settings.answer: No. Recovery depends on the device and the extent of the damage. We would rather be upfront about that than promise something we cannot deliver.

settings.title: What should I do if I think my drive is failing?
settings.answer: Stop using it. Continued use can make some failures worse. Contact us and tell us what happened before attempting additional repairs or recovery software.

settings.title: Will you look through my files?
settings.answer: We only access information as reasonably necessary to perform and verify the recovery. Your data is treated as private.

settings.title: How will I get my recovered data back?
settings.answer: That depends on the amount of data recovered. We will determine the appropriate storage and return method with you before completing the service.

settings.title: Returns, Warranty & Support
Do you accept returns?
settings.answer: Return eligibility depends on what you purchased and its condition. Custom, modified, and service related purchases may have different requirements than standard products. Our Return Policy has the complete terms.

settings.title: Are repairs guaranteed?
settings.answer: Coverage depends on the repair and parts used. Any warranty included with your service will be clearly communicated with your repair.

settings.title: Are custom builds covered by a warranty?
settings.answer: Coverage may include our workmanship as well as separate manufacturer warranties on individual components. Specific coverage will be provided with your build.

settings.title: What if something goes wrong after my repair?
settings.answer: Tell us. Send your original service information and explain what is happening. We will review it and figure out the appropriate next step.

settings.title: About Unpatched
What is Unpatched Tech?
settings.answer: We build, repair, restore, and rethink technology worth keeping. From modern PCs to hardware that has been around longer than some of us, good tech deserves a longer life.

settings.title: Do you only work with retro technology?
settings.answer: No. We love old hardware, but we are just as interested in what is coming next. Unpatched works across generations of technology.

settings.title: Why the name Unpatched?
settings.answer: Because technology was never meant to stay exactly the way it left the factory. We believe in fixing what is broken, improving what can be better, and keeping good hardware alive.

settings.title: How do I contact Unpatched?
settings.answer: Head to our Contact page and send us a message. For a project or repair, include the device and as much information as you can.

settings.title: What if my question is not here?
settings.answer: Ask us. Technology gets weird. We are used to it.

settings.title: FAQ
settings.content: Answers to the questions we get most about orders, builds, repairs, restorations, and everything in between.
